access.zh: API（Gemini API / Vertex）与 Gemini 应用订阅；权重不开源（开放权重的是另一条 Gemma 线）。
access.en: API (Gemini API / Vertex) and the Gemini app subscription; weights are not open (the open-weight line is Gemma).

generations.zh: Gemini 4 四档：Argon 2026-10-13 GA；Carbon 10-28 发布、11-10 开放；Hydrogen 11-12 上线；Neon 11-18 上线。官方模型页列 1M 上下文（官方文档与博客）。
generations.en: Four Gemini 4 tiers: Argon GA on 2026-10-13; Carbon announced 10-28 and opened 11-10; Hydrogen launched 11-12; Neon launched 11-18. Official model pages list 1M context (official docs and blog).

generations.zh: 当前代：官方模型总览页现役 gemini-3.8-flash（模型页 1,048,576 输入 / 65,536 输出、Preview 标注）；3.8 Flash 指南链接已从 3 系指南页挂出。指南页仍注明「所有 Gemini 3 模型目前均为预览版」。Google Cloud 模型版本页标注 gemini-3.8-flash 发布日期 2026-09-02（GA）。
generations.en: Current line: the official models overview lists gemini-3.8-flash (model page: 1,048,576 input / 65,536 output, Preview label); the 3.8 Flash guide is linked from the Gemini 3 guide page. The guide still notes all Gemini 3 models are currently in preview. The Google Cloud model-versions page lists gemini-3.8-flash release date 2026-09-02 (GA).

generations.zh: 上一代（2.5 Pro/Flash 等），官方文档仍在册。
generations.en: Previous line (2.5 Pro/Flash etc.), still listed in official docs.

v.zh: 1,048,576 tokens（Gemini 4 Argon 官方云文档；Carbon / Neon 同为 1M 档）
v.en: 1,048,576 tokens (official Gemini 4 Argon cloud docs; Carbon / Neon also sit at the 1M tier)

v.zh: Argon 统一输入输出上限 1,048,576；Carbon 单段 65,536（流式）/ 32,768（非流式）（官方文档与发布页）
v.en: Argon has a unified 1,048,576 input/output limit; Carbon caps a single segment at 65,536 (streaming) / 32,768 (non-streaming) (official docs and launch page)

v.zh: 按档位与用量计费，本站不抄具体数字；以官方模型页或发布页的定价表为准。
v.en: Billed by tier and usage; this site does not copy numbers — see the official pricing table.

v.zh: Argon 2026-10-13 正式版；Carbon 10-28 发布、11-10 开放；Hydrogen 11-12 上线；Neon 2026-11-18（官方文档与博客）
v.en: Argon GA on 2026-10-13; Carbon announced 10-28 and opened 11-10; Hydrogen launched 11-12; Neon on 2026-11-18 (official docs and blog)

v.zh: Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash：原生 15 秒视频生成与多轮对话式编辑，720p 定价较 1.1 下调 30%，2026-11-05 在 Gemini API 与 Google Cloud 正式可用；具体单价以官方发布页为准（官方发布页）。
v.en: Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash: native 15-second video generation and multi-turn conversational editing, priced 30% below 1.1 for 720p and generally available on the Gemini API and Google Cloud from 2026-11-05; see the official launch page for the current rate (official launch page).

v.zh: Carbon 打最难的长期项目；Argon 承担多数软件工程与知识工作；Neon 用 3 倍 Carbon 速度、60% 成本做高频复杂工作；Hydrogen 负责日常快速执行（官方博客）
v.en: Carbon takes the hardest long-horizon projects; Argon handles most software engineering and knowledge work; Neon does high-frequency complex work at 3x Carbon speed and 60% of its cost; Hydrogen handles fast everyday execution (official blog)

positioning.zh: Google 的闭源旗舰线；与开放权重的 Gemma 是两条线，别混。选型注意官方「预览版」标注——预览意味着规格与价格都可能变，这里只抄快照。
positioning.en: Google's closed flagship line; distinct from the open-weight Gemma line — do not conflate them. Note the official "preview" labels: preview means specs and prices may change; this site only snapshots.

onSite.zh: 开放权重侧这里有 Gemma 4（谱系卡 + 量化对比）；Gemini 系不开权重。
onSite.en: On the open-weight side this site covers Gemma 4 (family card + quantisation); the Gemini line ships no weights.
